reviews.reason: LazyTraceNodeItem initializes expanded from initiallyExpanded once; its onToggle then owns the user expansion independently. The nodes are keyed by trace_node_id. Continuously deriving expanded from the initial hint would discard user toggles; live query pages/status have their own resource owner. P21b reassessed 2026-11-17: Lazy trace now uses useInfiniteQuery for root/child pages and observes active backend runs; content keys include node status/finished time, polling/refetch follows live observations, and read errors render retry actions without changing execution status. Module-level trace components remain one keyed tree composition. The only initiallyExpanded state is user-owned after initialization and toggled independently, so deriving it continuously would erase interaction. Witness changes remove the old child reducer in favor of appendTraceChildrenPage and add execution identity/payload refresh; useContext remains a supported React 19 API.
